premise: Asta's story ends somewhere in the final war and he wakes as a newborn on the Hage church doorstep with every memory intact.

stateVector.external_world_state: identical to canon; Liebe sealed in the five-leaf grimoire inside the Hage grimoire tower; nobody else remembers

rules.rule: Anti-Magic requires access to the five-leaf grimoire and Liebe; it is not innate.
Memories do not transfer physique: sword work and any devil form are gated by the body's age and conditioning.
A five-leaf grimoire marks a devil host; exposure invites the Magic Parliament.
Ki is perception, not strength, so it can be trained before the body matures.
Characters act only on what they know in THIS timeline: only Asta has foreknowledge.

ledger.event: Targeted body conditioning; pendant incident — still loses the fight, still gets up. Yuno notices.

ripples.detail: Starts training years early; suspects Asta.

ledger.event: Enters the grimoire tower, speaks Licita's name, is overpowered by Liebe, wins him with the truth. Contract as equals. Cannot lift the sword; union unusable. Grimoire hidden under the church floor.

ripples.detail: Brotherhood ~10 years before the canon ritual.

ledger.event: Ceremony: no grimoire arrives (he already has it). Senses Revchi by Ki; ends the ambush in one swing. Yuno asks how long he has had the sword.

ripples.detail: Rivalry now built on a suspected secret.

ledger.event: Entrance exam: hides his level; only Yami takes him — and reads his Ki as a veteran's. Joins the Black Bulls by design.

ripples.detail: Knows Asta is hiding something; does not care.

ledger.event: Considers telling Julius; stops because of Lucius. The door opens anyway.
